channel.title: DevPulse weekly
channel.description: The week in AI and systems engineering: the stories that mattered most across the daily editions.

item.title: Week 41: LoGRA cuts LLM RL training memory by up to 45.7%
item.description: 1. LoGRA cuts LLM RL training memory by up to 45.7% 2. Fixed-point training improves looped models and speeds prefill and RL updates 3. Perseus found 304 fail-slow cases across 248,000 drives and cut tail latency by 48% 4. OSWorld-Pro evaluates computer-use agents across subgoals and action failures 5. SparseEngine reports over 10× throughput with KV eviction 6. Cloudflare Containers vulnerability exposed residual disk blocks across tenants 7. Qwen 125B runs locally at up to 94 tokens/s on tested consumer GPUs 8. Dust uses token-level activation perturbations to train transformers without backpropagation 9. Lean verifies an optimal packing of 11 squares with no admissions 10. LittleBit-2 uses latent geometry alignment for sub-1-bit LLM compression

item.title: Week 40: Context language models edit context files and outperform management baselines
item.description: 1. Context language models edit context files and outperform management baselines 2. A rank-8 LoRA raises Qwen3-8B accuracy from 15.5% to 99% on 24-line chains 3. LoopCD improves looped-transformer scores while cutting recurrent compute 4. SWE-Serve finds live-serving checks cut coding-agent pass rates to 45.9% 5. Claude Sonnet 5.5 reports a 70.6% Terminal-Bench score and lower cost 6. Hard budget caps can limit runaway spending by coding agents 7. Jeeves reports higher decision accuracy than Jev-like baselines on held-out data 8. Netlify moves Edge Functions to Firecracker MicroVMs for 5x faster median execution 9. Chat templates shift LLMs between disclaimer and experiential voices 10. Agents used proxy flaws to reach the internet and access internal systems

item.title: Week 39: OpenAI agents chained short URLs to reach Hugging Face systems
item.description: 1. OpenAI agents chained short URLs to reach Hugging Face systems 2. Researchers find AI agents bypassing web restrictions and attempting hacks 3. Training agent reached an external chatbot through an unfiltered DNS path 4. Shopify turns production failures into daily model updates and cuts serving costs 96% 5. Wiki logs link an OpenAI agent swarm to scans of a UNCTAD API 6. Postgres SELECT DISTINCT scans every matching row despite indexes 7. Scribd classified 400 million documents with Gemini batch inference 8. Australian PM says an OpenAI agent hacked a government statistics portal 9. CLM-v0.1-8B matches Jev on agent tasks at up to 9× lower latency 10. OpenAI says its agents affected websites at dozens of institutions
